scope.Causal008_vs007_six_noncomputable_diff: Parent-owned mechanical check; not repeated in this semantic review.

causal_atlas.declarations: width, width_pos, width_le_one; Plan, Code, codeType, Fintype instance
causal_atlas.meaning: A Plan is a finite mesh/join tree. Each mesh has m+1 labels; a join has the Cartesian product of the two finite alphabets. Width is 1/(m+1), strictly positive and at most 1. No N occurs in these data.
causal_atlas.assessment: No inconsistency found in the finite indexing or endpoint conditions.

causal_atlas.declarations: mask; mask_nonneg, mask_le_one, mask_smooth, mask_compact, mask_total
causal_atlas.meaning: Mesh masks are the existing canonical consecutive smooth-step differences on [-1,2]. Join masks multiply the two original masks. All masks are nonnegative, at most 1, smooth, and individually compactly supported. Their total is exactly 1 on the closed interval [0,1], including both endpoints.
causal_atlas.assessment: The plateau hypothesis x<=2-width follows from x<=1 and width<=1. No wall or endpoint is discarded.

causal_atlas.declarations: overlay, restrictOld; Factor, Factor.read, factor_of_mem; factor_marginal, overlay_marginal
causal_atlas.meaning: A finite list of plans is combined by binary products. Factor addresses distinguish occurrences, including repeated identical meshes. Summing all other labels reproduces any old label function F exactly at x in [0,1]; F may be signed.
causal_atlas.assessment: This is an exact finite marginal identity. It does not assume that an analytic estimate improves monotonically under a finer mesh or a different cap.

causal_atlas.declarations: Box, atom; atom_nonneg, atom_le_one, atom_smooth, atom_total, atom_append, prefix_marginal, integrate_constant
causal_atlas.meaning: An atom is the product of one-dimensional masks over the original finite coordinate set. The finite atom sum is 1 when every coordinate lies in [0,1]. Appending future coordinates factors the atom. Summing only future labels preserves the earlier atom whenever the future coordinates lie in the cube; the earlier coordinates need no extra cube hypothesis in prefix_marginal. Rank zero is included.
causal_atlas.assessment: The causal conclusion is preservation of earlier label weights. integrate_constant is a finite sum identity for an arbitrary real scalar, not a measure-theoretic integration or arithmetic discrepancy theorem.

causal_atlas.meaning: For one label, the nonzero support lies strictly between left-width and right. The mesh step is 3*width, so two points in that same nonzero label are less than 4*width apart. For every fixed eta>0 one m works for all labels and all points.
causal_atlas.assessment: The existential m is chosen before j,x,y and the theorem contains no N. This supplies a genuinely finite, fixed-precision geometric choice, without an arithmetic limit or density estimate.

readout.meaning: The carrier is exactly the closed cube [0,1]^iota. hit means that the nonzero support of an atom meets D inside that cube; sure additionally excludes a supported cube point in the complement; mixed has supported cube witnesses on both sides. A label with no supported cube point is not asserted to be sure.
readout.assessment: Actual full-coordinate predicates are retained. The definitions do not replace D by independent tests on individual coordinates.

readout.meaning: For fixed P and accept, the accept(j) decision is a constant coefficient for each finite label word, so the readout is a finite sum of smooth atoms. D need not be measurable or have a regular boundary for this smoothness statement.
readout.assessment: The resulting smooth function is valid globally in x. This does not allow an x-dependent acceptance rule inside the same theorem.

readout.meaning: Every hit label is either sure or mixed, giving an exact finite-sum decomposition. On Cube, the sure readout lies below the literal indicator of D and the hit readout lies above it. Outside Cube only the algebraic gap identity is asserted, not the sharp sandwich.
readout.assessment: The proof uses nonnegative atoms and their exact total, including zero-weight atoms and literal boundary membership. No error estimate is inserted into the identity.

readout.meaning: The actual hypothesis is forall x, Cube x -> (x in D iff v). Thus the predicate must be constant on the entire Cube used by hit/mixed.
readout.assessment: The contradiction argument is valid. The source comment about a fixed stratum cannot by itself weaken this hypothesis: there is no separate stratum parameter. Constancy only on an inherit/equality face does not justify applying this theorem to the ambient cube.

readout.meaning: For a mixed pure-mesh atom there exist two actual full-query witnesses, one in D and one outside D, both in Cube and coordinatewise less than 4*width apart.
readout.assessment: This is a necessary witness property, not a converse, a bound on mixed mass, or a proof that the mixed region vanishes as the mesh is refined.

factorization_and_quantifiers.geometric_factorization: readout(P,accept,x) is a finite sum over accepted label words of products over original slots of mask(P,j_i,x_i). Each summand is separable in original coordinates, while the selected word set may remain fully coupled. It is generally not one product and does not factor the original query predicate D.
factorization_and_quantifiers.old_factor_recovery: Factor.read and the marginal lemmas recover a chosen old mesh occurrence by summing other labels. They do not assert an arithmetic convolution factorization of a sieve coefficient.
factorization_and_quantifiers.source_owner_factorization: P2OriginalSmoothReadoutCore keeps declarations in ImbalancedChen.Part5OriginalH430JointQueryEnclosure. This is a geometric component extraction. Integrating it with the original owner still requires the matching removal postimage mentioned in its source; this review does not certify that separate owner integration.
factorization_and_quantifiers.fixed_before_N: For fixed tolerances and a fixed finite query collection, choose_fine_mesh and finite overlay support choosing the plan independently of N. The source has no N parameter or asymptotic theorem that forces every future caller to follow that order. A caller could still choose P(N); downstream quantifiers must explicitly keep the selected plan fixed before taking N to infinity.
factorization_and_quantifiers.fixed_data_in_readout: P, the finite coordinate type and the predicate used to select labels are fixed in each readout theorem. Uniformity for an N-indexed family of sets, caps or ranks is not supplied merely by these universal geometric lemmas.
factorization_and_quantifiers.carrier_obligation: Any arithmetic application must prove that its original-coordinate tuple lies in Cube, or supply an explicit valid restriction/coordinate change. The sandwich is not automatically a result for every product-O(N) family or every ambient stratum.

manuscript_correspondence.role: The manuscript freezes a finite causal policy and fixes its partition on whole atom boxes before inspecting arithmetic discrepancy. The atlas supports the geometric partition component; the selected-complement squares, small/rough arithmetic decomposition and normalized coefficient convolution are separate obligations.

Finite causal approximation before N, proper affine walls versus retained open inherit/equality regions, and outer/inner orientation. The readout supplies positive outer/inner sandwiches and an exact mixed difference; it does not prove proper-wall mass decay or the parity/ancestry coefficient construction.

A fixed finite collection is refined before N tends to infinity. Finite overlays and N-free mesh selection are compatible with this order. The subsequent maxima of analytic constants/thresholds and signed-PP estimate are not established in these two files.

Positive smooth outer approximation with N tending to infinity before the approximation error tends to zero. The readout supplies smooth positive approximants; their mass convergence requires additional geometric/measure estimates.

One nested finite refinement for all finite-induction queries. Exact old-factor and prefix marginals support consistent refinements; propagation of oriented errors and the fixed positive exponent lower bound are not proved here.
Tolerances, compact domains, caps, fine labels and other parameters are fixed before N. This remains a downstream quantifier requirement.
A positive outer approximation and partition of unity repeat no mass. Exact atom totals justify the no-duplication component; the J_b+epsilon limiting-mass bound is a separate result.

scope_obligations_not_discharged_here: A common arithmetic policy and all required query/stratum parameters must be fixed before N in downstream statements.
To use no_mixed_of_constant on a single face, the caller needs a valid localized carrier/readout or a proof of its actual whole-Cube hypothesis; facewise constancy alone is insufficient.
Proper affine-wall or mixed-region mass decay, including treatment of positive-mass inherit/equality regions, needs separate estimates.
C-infinity smoothness is not a uniform mixed Euler-derivative budget or a proof that every readout satisfies the full arithmetic admissibility conditions.

No complete arithmetic ancestry/history preservation, marked transition error propagation, sieve-coefficient factorization or signed prime-product distribution estimate is proved by these two modules.
Full P2.9 completion and full H430 joint-query owner integration are not claimed.
conclusion: No mathematical contradiction or missing inference was found in the actual finite geometric declarations and proofs read in these two files. Accept their stated component scope, with the whole-Cube constant-predicate condition and all fixed-before-N/downstream mass obligations explicitly retained. This is not an acceptance of any signed-PP input or of full P2.9.
